Join our team as a warehouse employee in Venlo, working for a leading logistics company. You can choose to work between 32 and 40 hours per week, with a competitive salary of €14.99 per hour. Our workplace is clean and safe, with teamwork at its core. 
Experience a dynamic work environment as you rotate through different departments, ensuring no two days are the same. Your tasks will include sorting, picking, and packing products for renowned international brands. Collaborate with colleagues from various countries and enhance your skills daily. Reliability and accuracy are crucial, and English language skills at A2 level are sufficient. 
If you're eager to start a career in logistics without prior experience, this is your opportunity. We provide excellent guidance, offer online training, and support your growth within the company. 
 Wij bieden - 
 - Competitive salary of €14.99 per hour; - Flexible working hours between 32 to 40 hours per week; - Options for full-time or part-time employment; - Potential for long-term employment; - Modern, clean, and safe work environment; - Access to online training and growth opportunities; - Work within an international team; - Supportive guidance and a pleasant work atmosphere; - Engaging and varied tasks; - Immediate start available. 
 Wij vragen - 
 - Minimum VMBO working and thinking level; - Proficiency in English at A2 level; - Reliability and accuracy in work; - Own transport required (location not accessible by public transport); - No prior experience in logistics required.

Are you a hands-on worker who enjoys working in a logistics environment? For our client, an international market leader in food processing solutions, we are looking for a Warehouse Operator for the Manufacturing Warehouse. In this role, you ensure that goods are delivered on time and to the correct location, so the production process continues to run smoothly at all times. Wie zoeken we? What you bring to the team: A completed lower secondary education (VMBO level or equivalent) A minimum of one year of experience working in a warehouse or logistics setting A good command of English — Dutch language skills are a welcome bonus A valid forklift- and reachtruck certificate Wat bieden wij je? What’s in it for you? A competitive monthly salary between €3,210.30 and €3,741.00 gross, based on a 40-hour work week A full-time position in day shifts (07:30 – 16:00), giving you your evenings free A 12-month contract with the possibility of extension based on performance The opportunity to work in an international, fast-paced, and collaborative team A position within a forward-thinking organization that’s driving innovation and sustainability in the global food industry Functieomschrijving Your role as a Warehouse Operator As a Warehouse Operator, you are the driving force behind smooth and efficient warehouse logistics. Every day, you make sure that all incoming and outgoing goods are handled accurately, safely, and on time. From receiving and inspecting materials to delivering them to the right production lines, your precision keeps operations running flawlessly. You’ll also take part in inventory control, prepare shipments, and actively look for ways to make our processes smarter and more efficient. In short: you are the backbone of the warehouse, ensuring that every product and component ends up exactly where it needs to be. Your main responsibilities: Accepting and verifying deliveries, including accompanying documentation Organising and storing materials in the correct

warehouse locations Picking and staging goods for production according to schedule Conducting stock counts and reporting any irregularities Packing, unpacking, and preparing goods for shipment Operating forklifts and reach trucks safely (a valid certificate is required — or can be obtained via SD Worx Jobs) Taking part in continuous improvement initiatives within the warehouse
